name: AI and data
summary: I turn your data into decisions, and build models and smart assistants that work inside your business.

meta.title: AI solutions, data analytics and chatbots | cod by nasser
meta.description: Dashboards from your data, sales forecasts, and AI chatbots that answer customers and automate routine work. Built on your own data, not a generic tool.

hero.title: AI and data
hero.say: Decisions from your numbers, and smart systems that work for you. I analyse your data and build on it models and assistants that work inside your business, on your own data, not on a general tool.

door.title: AI and data
door.say: Decisions from your numbers, and smart systems that work for you.

problems.question: You have numbers, and don’t know what they mean?
problems.why: Sales, customers and costs in scattered spreadsheets, and decisions still made by instinct.
problems.fix: I analyse your business and operations data, from sales, revenue and costs to your customers’ behaviour, and build you performance dashboards with your own indicators, so you decide from your numbers, not your instinct.
problems.name: Data analysis and performance dashboards

problems.question: Want to know what will happen, before it happens?
problems.why: Stock runs out or piles up, and fraud and risk show up too late.
problems.fix: I build machine learning models on your data that forecast sales and demand, detect anomalies and fraud, and assess and classify risk before it costs you.
problems.name: Forecasting and machine learning

problems.question: You need AI that knows your own business?
problems.why: Generic tools answer everything except questions about your business, and you pay for them every month.
problems.fix: I develop AI models made to fit your work: I train them on your data, or customise a ready model or a large language model, then measure its performance and improve it. That is how my project with Sberbank replaced a paid subscription.
includes: Adapting and improving large language models
problems.name: Custom AI models

problems.question: Your customers ask the same questions, and your team repeats the same work?
problems.why: Every question waits for your reply, and every order is copied and moved by hand.
problems.fix: I build smart assistants and AI agents that answer your customers and your team from your own data, hand the chat over to you when a person is needed, automate repetitive workflows, and connect to your databases and business systems.
includes: RAG systems on your organisation’s own data
An internal knowledge assistant for your team
Connecting to databases and business systems
problems.name: Smart assistants and automation

problems.question: Lots of images and documents, and one pair of eyes to review them?
problems.why: Manual review is slow and tiring, and mistakes in it are costly.
problems.fix: I build computer vision systems that understand documents and images, verify identity and papers, detect, recognise and track objects, and analyse satellite imagery. In medical images and X-rays, a tool that supports the doctor, not a replacement.
includes: Medical image and X-ray analysis, as a tool that supports the doctor
problems.name: Image and document analysis

problems.question: Many daily decisions, and limited resources?
problems.why: Routes, schedules and resource allocation are decided by trial and error, and time and money are lost.
problems.fix: I build reinforcement learning models and simulation-based systems that try the options before you do, improve routes and resource allocation, and suggest the best decision. They help you decide, and don’t decide for you.
problems.name: Optimisation and smart decisions

goal: The goal is a clearer decision, hours that come back to you, and customers who don’t wait.
